assumptions_made: Used a sample size of 100 documents from the Hugging Face dataset to keep within time constraints
When the Hugging Face dataset is unavailable, fell back to synthetic data with realistic-looking documents and labels
Created labels based on the first few words of documents to simulate topic-based relevance
Used a fixed retrieval K of 5 as specified in the design
Applied TF-IDF weighting using scikit-learn's built-in implementation
Used cosine similarity for nearest neighbor search as specified in the methods
Assumed that documents with the same label are relevant to each other
Used a maximum of 5000 features to balance memory usage and performance
Used a random seed of 42 for reproducibility

results.hypothesis: Test whether TF-IDF weighting improves nearest-neighbour retrieval precision over raw term counts.
results.author: coder-agent
results.success_criteria: TF-IDF improves precision at 5 by at least 0.05 over raw counts.
